note: Remove is_cold, is_windy, season_right — constant at predict time
justification: Correctness fix, not an accuracy win. All three take a single value for every predict-season row while varying in training: is_cold/is_windy derive from kickoff-measured temp/wind with fill_null(False), so 0.0% of 2026 rows read cold against 11-15% of training rows; season_right duplicates season exactly and carries 2026 against a 2025 training maximum, which a tree cannot extrapolate. Paired cost on Top-1 is nil in both markets (first_td -0.27pp p=0.810, anytime +0.44pp p=0.665). Top-3 and AUC guards trip on anytime; per the Phase 3e retraction a Top-3 move of this size follows any feature-set change, including additions of pure noise, so it is not read as evidence here. The walk-forward cannot see the defect at all, since every fold scores a played season where temp exists and season_right is in range.
